create_InferenceBatcher: create an InferenceBatcher instance to batch incoming inference requests with a predict unit
build_InferenceBatcher_with_context_mana: build an InferenceBatcher using a context manager that auto shuts down the executor on exit
run_batch_predictions: run batch predictions by submitting tasks to the InferenceBatcher executor using submit or map
shutdown_InferenceBatcher: shutdown the InferenceBatcher executor and wait for pending tasks to complete before returning
configure_concurrency_backend: configure the InferenceBatcher concurrency backend options to set max workers for thread pool execution
